title: Industrial Hubs and Global Supply Chains
grammar: Comparative multiples: kétszer akkora, mint / háromszor annyi, mint ('twice as large as / three times as many as')
goal: I can analyze the rise of automotive manufacturing hubs and foreign direct investment in Hungary.
I can construct comparative multiple structures (kétszer akkora, mint / háromszor több, mint / korábbihoz képest).
I can discuss global supply chains, export orientation, and assembly plants using B2 business Hungarian.
